title: ICSI Requests Extension for Company Compliance Facilitation Scheme 2026 Amidst MCA-21 Portal Glitches
content:
# ICSI Requests Extension for Company Compliance Facilitation Scheme 2026 Amidst MCA-21 Portal Glitches

Ek important update hai. The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) se Company Compliance Facilitation Scheme (CCFS) 2026 ki current deadline extend karne ki request ki hai, given the ongoing technical issues on the MCA-21 V3 portal.

*   **Current Deadline:** The Company Compliance Facilitation Scheme (CCFS) 2026 is currently set to expire on August 31, 2026. This deadline was previously extended via General Circular No. 03/2026 dated July 08, 2026.
*   **Reason for Extension Request:** ICSI has highlighted the practical difficulties faced by companies and professionals in completing statutory compliances due to the significant volume of filings and persistent technical issues experienced on the MCA-21 V3 portal. Many stakeholders require additional time to obtain necessary approvals and finalize their filing processes.
*   **Who Requested:** The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), through its President CS Pawan G. Chandak, submitted a formal representation dated August 20, 2026, to the MCA.
*   **Justification:** ICSI believes that a further extension would provide a reasonable additional window for companies to complete their pending compliances, thereby facilitating voluntary compliance, reducing the burden of historical defaults, and improving overall corporate governance.
